operational_rules: Whole existing tasks to4implementers perWP; Terra consolidates at end and delivers complete green PR
Supervisor receives complete PRs only; no micro-file delegation/review or partial-source integration
Supervisor stacks ready WP PRs and runs final epic/full suite bundle, retaining mandatory original release proofs
Every failure returns to author WP team for correction until accepted
Leads coordinate producer/consumer dependencies directly; WP00 owns shared contract compatibility, scope unchanged
Oneprimary worktree/branch perWP; sole Git/index/finaltester Terra; disjoint helperwrites
Only Terra runs finalWP surgical hosted tests, no intermediateCI or local producttests
Reuse SAME live sessions/lanes; stable instruction prefix and changed task/checkpoint delta only; no repeated entirepacks
Keep access to all criteria; no fake provider caching promises, measure cache usage when exposed
Do not send root each microcommit/report; report readyPR with head/checks/evidence or real external blocker, finish independent work first
No new controller/supervisor or cancellation/budget/hostpermission bypass

required: Terra final hosted surgical checks runs and exact SHAs

integration_checkpoint.status: preserve existing work; suspend microdreno until readyWP PRs

phase_clarification.source: Pinned workflow READY_FOR_INTEGRATION differs from DONE; user requires PRs then final epic
phase_clarification.FINAL_WP_GATE_READY: All required product implementation and relevant consumers available; Terra may request final surgical hosted validation before a green PR exists. Do not require green to obtain CI lease.
phase_clarification.READY_FOR_BUNDLE: Complete product implementation, own mandatory findings closed and final WP scoped hosted proof, PR/dependency/criterion mappings delivered; final integrated campaign proofs may be explicitly pending.
phase_clarification.DONE: Only after applicable criteria and final candidate proof are satisfied. Never count READY_FOR_BUNDLE as delivered GLOBAL_RELEASE.
phase_clarification.no_circular_gate: WP10.T04/T05 campaign execution/receipts require the final bundle; their code/harness/config/operational inputs must be delivered first. Do not require final epic/AM/C/D receipts as prerequisites to constructing that same bundle.
phase_clarification.not_a_waiver: Missing product code, broken consumers or missing supported runtime authority are implementation gaps, not deferred final evidence.
